calls.statement:
WITH dim_date_filter AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, calendar_date
  FROM dim_date
  WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
),
net_lines AS (
  -- Sales from FY2026/27 weeks 1-22
  SELECT 
    f.sale_date,
    s.store_id,
    cs.region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS sale_net,
    SUM(f.standard_cost) AS cost
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_date_filter dd ON d.fiscal_year = dd.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_week = dd.fiscal_week
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
    AND s.store_id != 999
    AND cp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY f.sale_date, s.store_id, cs.region
),
returns AS (
  -- Returns from FY2026/27 weeks 1-22
  SELECT 
    r.return_date,
    s.store_id,
    cs.region,
    SUM(r.refund_net) AS refund_net,
    SUM(r.standard_cost_returned) AS cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  JOIN dim_date_filter dd ON d.fiscal_year = dd.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_week = dd.fiscal_week
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
    AND s.store_id != 999
  GROUP BY r.return_date, s.store_id, cs.region
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(sale_net) AS net_sales_sales,
    SUM(refund_net) AS net_sales_returns
  FROM (
    SELECT region, sale_net AS net_sales_sales, 0 AS refund_net
    FROM net_lines
    UNION ALL
    SELECT region, 0, refund_net
    FROM returns
  )
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  COALESCE(net_sales_sales, 0) - COALESCE(net_sales_returns, 0) AS net_sales,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(net_sales_sales, 0) - COALESCE(net_sales_returns, 0) DESC) AS rank
FROM region_totals
ORDER BY rank

WITH net_sales AS (
  -- Sales lines from FY2026/27 weeks 1-22
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    cs.region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS sales_amount,
    0 AS return_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND s.store_id != 999
    AND cp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, cs.region
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Return lines from FY2026/27 weeks 1-22
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    cs.region,
    0 AS sales_amount,
    SUM(r.refund_net) AS return_amount
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
    AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 1 AND 22
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND s.store_id != 999
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, cs.region
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    SUM(sales_amount) - SUM(return_amount) AS net_sales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sales_amount) - SUM(return_amount) DESC) AS rank
  FROM net_sales
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  rank,
  region,
  ROUND(net_sales, 2) AS net_sales
FROM region_totals
ORDER BY rank
